brief: Resolves colour names and answers colour questions for diagrams: the text colour that reads on a background, RGB values, grey, and palette lookups.
detail: It holds no state. A colour is a name, a semantic name such as success, a name with a shade mark such as blue+, or a #rrggbb code. Unknown names resolve to white in ColorToRGB and to an empty text in ResolveWithPalette. stzDiagram forwards its colour helpers to it.
